name: Nagahisa Chiharu
source:
The boisterous cross dressing BL fanatic kouhai.
He cross dresses to see love between men from a woman's viewpoint, he wishes to observe such a relationship from afar to the end.

While he is reluctant in being chosen as one of Masato's lovers it is a chance for him to see love between men up close. He is constantly encouraging Masato to pursue a same sex love(much to his dismay) as well as one-sidedly talking to him about BL, they get along quite well.
